notes.title: New Update – Improved Clue System
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a small update to improve the clue system in [i]How 2 Escape[/i].[/p][p]Previously, players had to send keywords to their companion—but many mistook those keywords as the clues themselves, which led to confusion. To make things clearer, we’ve replaced the keywords with password-style codes (e.g., [b]785rkb[/b]).[/p][p]This change should make it much easier to distinguish between the input and the actual clue, helping you focus on solving puzzles and enjoying the escape experience.[/p][p]Thanks for continuing to play [i]How 2 Escape[/i]![/p]

notes.title: A New How 2 Escape Game is Launching This Year!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’re excited to announce that we have a new How 2 Escape game coming this year! Announced during today’s MIX Spring Showcase, How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine puts you and a friend on an underwater adventure where you must prevent a potential war!

[h1]How 2 Escape returns![/h1]
The same unique co-op experience that’s been optimized with new challenges. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609918/6b385c95eb2c55de39c77c5c8d6fd993ddaed630.jpg[/img]
[h2]We're proud to announce today How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine, a new episode in the How 2 Escape franchise![/h2]

The latest edition in the How 2 Escape series, How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine, has you and a partner work together to locate a missing submarine and prevent the start of a global war. 

[previewyoutube=ssV2PNmXuEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Team up with a friend to reach a lost submarine and prevent the outbreak of war. Work together on two devices to solve increasingly challenging puzzles, where each of you has your own unique role to play. 

How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine will be available in 2025 on Steam and consoles. 
Free companion app for the player 2 will be available on PC (Steam), Android and iOS. 

[h2]Wishlist How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine today: [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530680/How_2_Escape_Lost_Submarine/

[h3]Story:[/h3]
An important allied military base has been captured by enemy forces, prompting the government to preemptively order the launch of a torpedo to reclaim it - despite the potential for countless allied deaths. 

However, after further internal discussions and negotiations with the enemy, the government has cancelled the strike that could spark a potential global war. The only problem is "The Triumphant," the submarine carrying the torpedo, is out of communication range and no one can confirm if the cancellation orders have reached the submarine. 

To prevent war, the government has tasked its two best experts, officers Haurée and Leroy, to locate “The Triumphant” before time runs out. These two strategic masterminds of the submarine fleet will face a reality they did not expect, as recent decisions have ignited a moral dilemma among the underwater sailors.

See you in 2025! ♥
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530680/How_2_Escape_Lost_Submarine/

notes.title: Welcome to the newcomers & small update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're writing a little spontaneous post on Steam, as many of you have been asking about the game since the french livestream from Wankil Studio (thanks for the live stream!).

Since the launch at the very end of August, we've made a lot of changes to the game, and we're continuing to improve it all the time. 

[h2]Some facts to know about the game[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game is played by two players. One on Steam, the other on mobile or on Steam via the Companion app (free, whether or not you have the main game). 
[*] You and your partner do not have the same game screen. Puzzles are procedurally generated, so solutions may differ from one game to the next. 
[Internet is not required to play! Everything synchronizes via codes you send to each other during the game. You can play the game in the same room, on the phone, via Discord and more...
[*] The hint system has been improved to make it simpler. Don't forget to text (via the companion app) the clues recovered by the player locked in the train.
[*] There's a color-blind mode available! 
[*] You'll find 7 cars in the game, getting harder and longer!
[*] The game is 100% French, from a Parisian publisher, Just For Games, and a Lyon-based developer, Breakfirst Games! :)
[/list]

[h2]No one to play with?[/h2]
Join our Community Discord to talk with the team and why not find a partner to play the game with you!
The link is [url=https://discord.gg/anykk5pk7Q]here![/url]

If you like the game, don't hesitate to post a positive review on Steam, it helps us enormously! We've had a little bit of review bombing because the Chinese language isn't quite up to par with the other languages in the game.  We're in the process of reworking it with a new partner, but the negative reviews coming from this Chinese version are weighing down the overall rating of the game, which is really bothering us :(

Have a good escape, Emy & Johan!
Just For Games & Breakfirst Games

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.notes:
Here are some answers to questions you asked us on our discord:

[u]How to synchronize with your mate?[/u]
There is no connection required! PC/Console player has to start a new game to get all the information you need to get started together.


[u]On which platforms will the game be released?[/u]
The “main game” will be released on PC and major consoles (Switch, PS4|5, Xbox one et series X|S).

The free companion app will be made available on Android & iOS devices. We will also release a PC version of the companion app, for those who prefer to play this way.

Sorry for the MAC players, there's no MAC version planned.


[u]Are there any accessibility options ?[/u]
We are currently working on a mode that will let colorblind players enjoy the game as well. It will also be possible to disable the timer for people that prefer a softer experience.


[u]When the game will be available?[/u]
How 2 Escape will be released on August 31st 2023!


[u]What languages will be available?[/u]
We've localized the game in English, Spanish, German, Portuguese and Italian. More languages might be announced soon so stay tuned!

[h3]Find a teammate.[/h3]
If you need someone to play with, we have our official Discord open to let you find a teammate!
Discord : [url=https://discord.gg/7YkeQAnHwu]https://discord.gg/7YkeQAnHwu[/url]

[h3]Q&A[/h3]

We've prepared a couple of Q&A for you. We'll go in-depth during our live tomorrow!

[u][i]How long will the full game last ?[/i][/u]

We’ve crafted 7 rooms and each one contains about 3 riddles. Depending on your skills and efficiency, this should take from 7 to 9 hours.

[u][i]Will the riddles change between two playthroughs?[/i][/u]

Riddles will keep the same structure. However most of them contain different combinations, meaning that the solution will change from one playthrough to another.

[u][i]On which platforms will the game be released?[/i][/u]

The “main game” will be released on PC and major consoles (Switch, PS4/5, Xbox).
The free companion app will be made available on Android & iOS devices. 
We will also release a PC version of the companion app, for those who prefer to play this way.

[u][i]Are there any accessibility options ?[/i][/u]

Yes, we are currently working on a mode that will let colorblind players enjoy the game as well. It will also be possible to disable the timer for people that prefer a softer experience, even if it’s not the way we designed the game to be played.

Thank you!
Breakfirst & Just For Games teams!

notes.title: How 2 Escape Demo is now here!
notes.notes:
We're super happy to join the Puzzle Fest from Steam today and being able to offer you a first try of our unique concept in the cooperative escape game How 2 Escape! 

You can now try it in its first playable demo available starting today!  Solve the first series of puzzles with your partner today and discover the unique gameplay offered by How 2 Escape.

Join the official Discord : [url=https://discord.gg/7YkeQAnHwu]https://discord.gg/7YkeQAnHwu[/url]  to find a mate to play the game or follow [url=https://twitter.com/how2escape_Game]@how2escape_Game[/url]  on Twitter to get all the information!

In How 2 Escape, players will have to talk and collaborate to find the solution: one player, trying to escape, will play on a computer or console and the second, trying to help the first player, will play on a phone with the free dedicated companion app.

Internet is NOT required to play: whether you are in the same room, on the phone or on a chat app, anything works to play How 2 Escape together! 

The only rule: It's a game that relies on communication, so talk to one another and keep your screen for yourself!

Official How 2 Escape - Companion App is available for free today on iOS* (via Testflight) and Android.
